decision: Activate the selected one-trial E0 Nanoda semantic-diversity inventory after recording its exact input identities and before generator execution. Keep the exact historical short-process memory audit deferred and BUILD-MODE planned; no successor execution or external action is authorized by entry.

categories.assessment: The E0 screen is the smallest fresh semantic-target search enabled by the new lane. BUILD-MODE remains a possible later confirmation method, while the memory audit is interpretive rather than exploratory.

The E0 trial reuses the mutation catalog, coverage and registry to seek a concrete next test target. The memory audit retains the exact eighteen-receipt accounting unknown and remains independently useful.
Closure reliability maintenance is complete subject to its mechanical receipt. No substantive upstream feedback or deadline displaces executable local exploration.
The selected trial reuses the existing semantic-diversity selector and pinned local inputs without adopting a new method. No literature refresh is needed for this source-inventory-only screen.

The E0 screen answers whether concrete fresh targets exist before building them. BUILD-MODE still lacks bound source-selected sites/configurations; the memory audit removes an interpretation gap but does not unblock fresh semantic testing.

candidates.rationale: One no-write deterministic inventory trial has an exact source, sample, signal rule, retained raw-output path and E0-only conclusion boundary.
The exact read-only audit is feasible and retained, but its interpretation of a completed historical matrix has lower immediate discovery value than determining whether fresh semantic targets exist.
The candidate remains planned rather than executable until source/configuration review identifies a concrete observable site and fixed protocol.

blockers.reason: Supported configurations, reproducible toolchain, input-influenced source sites and the fixed fixture/build protocol are not yet bound.
